---
title: "Popularity of the Name Carly Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the SSA baby names dataset
baby_names <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv")

# Filter for "Carly" and total the count for each year
carly_names <- baby_names |>
  filter(name == "Carly") |>
  summarize(count = sum(count), .by = year)

# Plot the number of babies named Carly over time
ggplot(carly_names, aes(x = year, y = count)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Carly in the U.S. Over Time",
    subtitle = "Annual baby counts from the Social Security Administration",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
